Prayer is for quashing of Fir being Crime No.1211 of 2021 for an offence punishable under
Sections 406, 498A r/w 34 of Ipc and consequential charge-sheet being Case No.PW/69/2023
pending on the file of Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, 22 nd Court, Andheri.

2. Counsel for the petitioners informs that the petitioners Bgp. 1 of 2 (2)-Wp-3333-23 &
3726-22.doc.
are connected through virtual mode.
3. The respondent No.2/complainant is present in the Court.

Petitioner/husband has placed on record an affidavit thereby undertaking that an amount of Rs.7,00,000/- shall be deposited in the Apurba Kumar Chanda And Anr vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 16 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131914295/
